    Lemma 7.4 and Proposition 7.5 for a representation-finite algebra #

    lem:integer-weight-lifting and prop:primitive-parameter-characters (weights-and-parameters.tex), for the algebra A₀ of a basic representation-finite algebra A, connected as in the source (IsConnectedRing: only the central idempotents 0 and 1). Connectedness passes to A₀ (a0Conn_ar), which gives the lifted walks from a base projective used in the proofs (hK_of_A0Conn; the source cites [ARS, Theorem VII.2.1] for the connectedness of Γ_A). Every mesh of Γ_A has a nonzero middle term (ar_hmid, from the exactness of the mesh data).

    theorem MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.IndSkeleton.a0Conn_ar {k A : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [Ring A] [Algebra k A] [FiniteDimensional k A] [IsNoetherianRing Aᵐᵒᵖ] (S : IndSkeleton k A) (b : S.ArrowBases) (hbasic : IsBasicAlgebra A) (hconn : IsConnectedRing A) (v₀ : S.ARVertex) (x₀ : (S.arMeshData b).PV) :
    MeshWalk.A0Conn S.arTranslationQuiver (S.arCoefficients b) v₀ (S.arMeshData b) x₀

    A connected basic algebra has a connected A₀: the splitting of A over A₀ (Lemma 6.4 for the radical filtration, posFiltA) carries the vertex idempotents of A₀ to a complete set of nonzero orthogonal idempotents of A and their corners to corners, so the corner graph of A₀ is connected (eqvGen_corner).

    theorem MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.IndSkeleton.integerWeightLifting {k A : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [Ring A] [Algebra k A] [FiniteDimensional k A] [IsNoetherianRing Aᵐᵒᵖ] (S : IndSkeleton k A) (b : S.ArrowBases) (v₀ : S.ARVertex) (hbasic : IsBasicAlgebra A) (hconn : IsConnectedRing A) (M : Type) [AddCommGroup M] :
    (∀ (h : MeshWalk.WP S.arTranslationQuiver (S.arCoefficients b) v₀ (S.arMeshData b) →+ M), ∃ (W : MeshWalk.MeshWt S.arTranslationQuiver M), MeshWalk.MeshWt.res (S.arCoefficients b) (S.arMeshData b) W = h) ∧ (∀ (W : MeshWalk.MeshWt S.arTranslationQuiver M), MeshWalk.MeshWt.res (S.arCoefficients b) (S.arMeshData b) W = 0 ↔ ∃ (ζ : S.ARVertex → M), (∀ (p : (S.arMeshData b).PV), ζ ↑p = 0) ∧ (∀ {y x : S.ARVertex} (a : y ⟶ x), W.w a = ζ x - ζ y) ∧ ∀ (x : ↑S.arTranslationQuiver.nonprojective), W.ν x = ζ ↑x - ζ ↑(S.arTranslationQuiver.tau x)) ∧ ∀ (ζ : S.ARVertex → M), (∀ (p : (S.arMeshData b).PV), ζ ↑p = 0) → (∀ {y x : S.ARVertex} (x_1 : y ⟶ x), ζ x = ζ y) → ζ = 0

    Lemma 7.4 (lem:integer-weight-lifting) for A₀ = kP of a basic connected A: a mesh weight restricts to a ray weight (MeshWt.res), and 0 → {ζ : ζ_P = 0} → H^mesh → H → 0 is exact (with values in any abelian group M): every ray weight is a restriction; a mesh weight restricts to zero exactly when it is w(a) = ζ_{target a} − ζ_{source a}, ν_v = ζ_v − ζ_{τv} for object values vanishing at the projectives; and such object values are determined by their differences.

    theorem MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.IndSkeleton.primitiveParameterCharacters {k A : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [Ring A] [Algebra k A] [FiniteDimensional k A] [IsNoetherianRing Aᵐᵒᵖ] (S : IndSkeleton k A) (b : S.ArrowBases) (h2 : 2 = 0) (v₀ : S.ARVertex) (hbasic : IsBasicAlgebra A) (hconn : IsConnectedRing A) :
    ∃ (SR : ScalarMeshCategory.RowSet S.arTranslationQuiver), (∀ R ∈ SR, ↑R.fst ∈ S.arTranslationQuiver.periodic) ∧ (∀ R ∈ SR, ∀ R' ∈ SR, ↑R'.fst ∈ S.arTranslationQuiver.component ↑R.fst → R = R') ∧ ScalarMeshCategory.CokerSpan (S.arCoefficients b) SR ∧ Set.Finite SR ∧ (∃ (Wu : MeshWalk.MeshWt S.arTranslationQuiver (MeshWalk.WP S.arTranslationQuiver (S.arCoefficients b) v₀ (S.arMeshData b))), MeshWalk.MeshWt.res (S.arCoefficients b) (S.arMeshData b) Wu = AddMonoidHom.id (MeshWalk.WP S.arTranslationQuiver (S.arCoefficients b) v₀ (S.arMeshData b))) ∧ ∀ (Wu : MeshWalk.MeshWt S.arTranslationQuiver (MeshWalk.WP S.arTranslationQuiver (S.arCoefficients b) v₀ (S.arMeshData b))), MeshWalk.MeshWt.res (S.arCoefficients b) (S.arMeshData b) Wu = AddMonoidHom.id (MeshWalk.WP S.arTranslationQuiver (S.arCoefficients b) v₀ (S.arMeshData b)) → ∃ (ι : Type) (bs : Module.Basis ι ℤ (MeshWalk.WP S.arTranslationQuiver (S.arCoefficients b) v₀ (S.arMeshData b))) (j : ↑SR → ι), Function.Injective j ∧ ∀ (R : ↑SR), bs (j R) = MeshWalk.rowWt Wu ↑R

    Proposition 7.5 (prop:primitive-parameter-characters) for A₀ = kP of A with basic and connected A, in characteristic two: for rows p_i at v_i as in Proposition 6.1(2) (at periodic vertices, one per component, spanning the cokernels), the residual characters χ_i = w(p_i) − ν_{v_i} of the universal mesh weight w (restricting to the identity of L = W(P), Lemma 7.4) are part of an integer basis of W(P).
